label: Studio, one softbox (shipped)
look: Full-frame camera on a tripod, sharp where it is focused and softly out of focus behind, deep clean shadows, true colour and no grain, the frame square and level. She wears her hair loose, with a few strands pushed behind one ear. A single large softbox stands close to one side of her and a white fill card faces it from the other. Bare studio floor runs away underfoot, a roll of seamless paper is clamped to a stand behind her, and a folded reflector leans against the far wall.
verdict: session 381, 10 seeds: the ten frames agree on her hair 10/10, the ninety-degree profile arrives 10/10 full body, and the softbox, tripod, paper roll and reflector are all built
